confidence: High comparative suspicion of Art, not conclusive identification: his combination is strongest, but evidence is circumstantial and several exclusions rely on self-report.
plausibility_notes: No final unique vial ownership, tear match, fingerprint, timed preview roll or continuous glass-handling observation is released.
Common-paper match cannot itself rule out Chip, Dada or Minnie; absence of admitted glass touch is not absence of opportunity.
Art's archived-correction assertion reduces a simple publication-concealment motive if true, but demands independent corroboration.
Other characters' scandal explanations largely resolve their printed clues without supplying complete murder exclusions.
The most economical supported account is Art extracting poison at preview and transferring it while moving the glass; precise extraction, transport and disposal remain inferred.
